title: Repair local references while keeping the active connection
when: When local credentials point at a deleted file or the recorded actor belongs to another universe.
need: Run local initialization without force for stale references; preserve the active connection unless explicitly selecting local; use Doctor to name missing credentials and invalid actors.
disclosure: Init repair output, init --activate help, and Doctor connection findings.
review: Candidate source regression tests cover repair and active connection preservation; deployed proof remains pending.
